LESSON: MY FRIENDS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1
Subject: General
Strand: My Neighbourhood
Topic 4.2: My friends
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers My friends, part of My Neighbourhood in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: where they can use 1. Who is your friend? 2. Why do we have friends? 3. Why do we use polite words? 4. How do polite words help us live with others?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on My friends together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Love: caring - as learner respects others while using polite words in interactions.

● Peace: empathy - as learner uses courteous words in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Social cohesion as learner sings songs together with other learners.

● Developmental perspectives as learner copes with emotions when playing together with friends

Link to other learning area:

Language Activities: The learner is able to relate the skills acquired in Language Activities as they fingerspell and sign courteous words

used in conversations.
